consequence.statement: Traffic from policy-selected node-local backends destined to the policy's frontend is redirected back to the node-local backends by default.
consequence.remediation: Create local redirect policies with skipRedirectFromBackend set to true to override.

assertion.statement: With socket-based load-balancing, Local Redirect Policy now redirects traffic from policy-selected node-local backends to the policy frontend back to the local backends by default; set skipRedirectFromBackend: true to override.
